summary: Re-test of iter55 doc_id bug fixes. All 21 pytest tests pass (10 unit + 11 e2e), including the new guardrail test_field_leadership_resolver_in_sync_with_kinds and the previously-xfailed test_post_field_leadership_supervisor_notes_prefix which now PASSES (mints FLN-* not FL-*). Mongo aggregation confirms every field_leadership_records.kind now has a kind-specific prefix and zero records remain on the catch-all FL- bucket. Admin search end-to-end: DR-2026-00007 navigates to /admin/daily/<uuid> and renders the daily report with the new red 'DOC ID DR-2026-00007' badge visible next to 'REPORT ID'. Bug iter55-(a) FULLY FIXED. Bug iter55-(b) PARTIALLY FIXED: 8 of 10 collection routes now resolve to existing App.js paths, but 2 still don't — see frontend_issues.

minor.issue: For safety_equipment_issuances and safety_equipment_trainings, the route map returns '/admin/safety?focus_issuance=<id>' / '/admin/safety?focus_training=<id>'. App.js has NO /admin/safety route — only '/admin' (exact match) and '/safety/*'. Lookups for SEI-* and SET-* doc_ids will dead-end on a blank page (same class of bug iter55 was supposed to close). The safety forms admin panel actually lives inside <AdminHub /> at /admin (AdminHub.jsx:461), so the simplest fix is route='/admin?focus_issuance=<id>' and let AdminHub auto-scroll/focus the AdminSafetyFormsPanel.

ui_bugs.issue: Looking up an EQR-/FLW-/FLN-/FL* doc_id from /admin redirects to /leadership/records/<uuid>, but FieldLeadershipView's gate kicks the admin out to /leadership login instead of honoring the admin token (test_credentials.md states 'Admin and PM tokens implicitly satisfy the gate', so this is unexpected). Verified manually: search EQR-2026-00012 → URL becomes /leadership/records/<id> then bounces to /leadership login screen. UX dead-end for the admin even though the route exists.
App.js has no /admin/safety route; SEI-*/SET-* lookups will land on a blank page.

action_items: Fix server.py find-by-doc-id route map for safety_equipment_issuances/trainings: change '/admin/safety?focus_issuance=<id>' to '/admin?focus_issuance=<id>' (and '/admin?focus_training=<id>') so the existing AdminHub renders, OR register a new <Route path='/admin/safety' element={<AdminHub initialFocus='safety-forms'/>}/> in App.js. Add a smoke test that asserts every route returned by find-by-doc-id resolves on the React side.

Investigate why FieldLeadershipView (/leadership/records/:id) is bouncing admins to /leadership login. test_credentials.md says admin tokens should implicitly satisfy the gate — either the gate code is checking only X-Leadership-Token instead of falling through to admin, or the page is calling a leadership-only API. Either fix the gate to accept admin tokens, OR mint an admin-side viewer like /admin/leadership/<id> and re-point the find-by-doc-id route map there for field_leadership_records.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:7034-7066 route map is now hand-rolled per collection — exactly the dual-source-of-truth pattern that caused iter55's bug. Recommend either (a) returning collection+id from the API and letting a single frontend registry pick the route, or (b) writing a tiny CI test that walks the route map and asserts each path matches an App.js Route — would have caught the /admin/safety gap on this very iteration.

FieldLeadershipView gate behavior is undocumented in code — relying on a memo file (test_credentials.md) for 'admin tokens implicitly satisfy' is fragile. Move the policy into FieldLeadershipView itself with an explicit comment + admin-token short-circuit.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 pytest, prev-xfail now PASS, 0 records left on FL-)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (DR/EQR-with-doc-badge proven; SEI/SET routes still broken; leadership gate bounces admins)

Both will be quick fixes in server.py find-by-doc-id route map (~lines 7041-7064) plus a smoke test in conftest. rca of the issue: iter55 bug (a) — supervisor_notes singular/plural drift — fully resolved: doc_ids._field_leadership_prefix now keys on plural 'supervisor_notes' (and the new guardrail test_field_leadership_resolver_in_sync_with_kinds prevents regressions by iterating every kind in FIELD_LEADERSHIP_KINDS). Mongo confirms 27 supervisor_notes are FLN, 0 records on FL. iter55 bug (b) — find-by-doc-id route map vs App.js drift — only 80% resolved: 8/10 collections now point at real App.js paths (verified DR=/admin/daily/<id> renders correctly with the new red doc-id badge). The 2 remaining gaps are a pure route-map error in server.py (no App.js change needed for safety forms; /admin already renders the panel inline) and a gate-policy oversight in FieldLeadershipView (admin tokens not honored). Reproduction: type DR-2026-00007 + Find on /admin → real page renders; type SEI-2026-00001 → /admin/safety?focus_issuance=<id> → React Router has no match → blank page; type EQR-2026-00012 → /leadership/records/<id> → leadership login gate. Mitigation: server.py route map either co-locates with App.js routes via a shared registry, or trades concrete routes for a {collection,id} response that the frontend resolves through a single switch.
